audience.reader: An engineer deciding whether to let an agent build something they will have to defend
audience.decision: whether the proof this platform produces is worth the ceremony it costs
priorBeliefs: agent output cannot be trusted and cannot be checked either
every proof framework is a report generator with extra steps

sources.describes: The node-platform repository at the commit these claims were produced from

claims.statement: The platform runs its own gates against itself, and the run is recorded rather than reported.
claims.boundary: It establishes that the suite ran and what it returned. It does not establish that the suite tests the right things.

claims.statement: The opportunity contract is derived from the repository's own documentation, and the fields the docs do not support are named as unverified.
claims.boundary: Naming a field unverified is not the same as verifying the rest.

claims.statement: A sweep for undeclared behaviour ran and produced a receipt, so an empty result and an unasked question do not look the same.
claims.boundary: The sweep surfaced nothing. That is a recorded zero, not a guarantee there was nothing to find.

withheldClaims.detail: cites ev-velocity-study, which the build evidence pack does not contain — a reference that resolves to nothing is an invented capability, not a typo

demoMode.reason: the platform is the product; there is no demo data

notRun: Whether any statement is TRUE was not assessed. This producer checks that a claim's references resolve and that its phrasing does not promise more than its data origin supports; both are lookups, and neither is truth.
Whether the narrative is persuasive, well-ordered, or appropriate for the named reader was not assessed.
Whether the audience record names the right reader was not assessed — it was supplied, not derived.

inherited from the build stage: No semantic assessment of the built system against any contract decision was performed by this producer; every pointer without caller-supplied evidence is recorded as defaulted-with-disclosure, not honoured.
inherited from the build stage: No human has read the disclosure artifact; it exists on disk with a digest, and nothing more is claimed for it.
inherited from the build stage: The emergent sweep inventoried tracked file paths only; decisions expressed inside code semantics, copy, or configuration values were not searched for.

inherited from the build stage: No adversarial review was run. This pack carries the author's own test command and no independent attempt to break the build, which is unfalsified rather than verified.

refused.item: claim sc-faster: Teams ship 40% faster with NodeKit.
refused.reason: no-build-evidence — cites ev-velocity-study, which the build evidence pack does not contain — a reference that resolves to nothing is an invented capability, not a typo

refused.item: Marking any contract decision honoured without caller-supplied evidence files
refused.reason: inherited from the build stage: An honoured disposition asserts the build did something specific, and this producer cannot see intent — only bytes and exit codes. Where no evidence was supplied it defaulted with disclosure instead.

inherited from the build stage: Authorization is derived by verification from an attestation. A producer granting it to itself is the self-approval the authority model forbids, so the field is pinned false.
